publicationScope: Every listed entry has public-ready standing and an exact source package in this projection.

skills.name: architecture-convergence-vantages
skills.title: Architecture convergence vantages
skills.description: Coordinates bounded technical vantages around a consequential implementation choice and synthesizes one guarantee map, fitting architecture, and receiving route. Applies when several plausible changes affect concurrency, recovery, portability, evidence, or publication differently.

skills.name: contextual-jargon-scan
skills.title: Contextual jargon scan
skills.description: Classifies potentially specialist or inside wording within a bounded corpus and revises replaceable shorthand into ordinary language. Applies when Registry orientation, artifact documentation, public projection copy, or cross-team prose may rely on context its reader does not share.

skills.name: probe-bearing-exemplar-formation
skills.title: Probe-bearing exemplar formation
skills.description: Forms a first reviewable registry coordinate from a source-grounded technical question, focused evidence, and a named receiving use. Applies when a public-safe code sample, Practitioner Probe, or domain exemplar is ready for its first registry version.

skills.name: transaction-boundary-evidence-mapping
skills.title: Transaction boundary evidence mapping
skills.description: Maps a logical operation's meaning, accepted-state dependency, aligned effects, publication point, retry outcomes, and evidence owners. Applies when several state changes must become visible together or retry correctness depends on whether publication occurred.

skills.name: versioned-exemplar-successor
skills.title: Versioned exemplar successor
skills.description: Carries a material technical strengthening from an accepted registry artifact into a new runnable version and exact derived teaching surfaces. Applies when stronger implementation, comments, tests, or evidence would exceed an immutable version's demonstrated behavior.
